ambient_events: The air in Vex Hollow hums at a pitch you feel in your fillings.
Something the wrong size for its shape shifts in a den at the hollow's edge and fixes on you.
description: A sunken hollow just inside the Redline where the air sits still and hums, and the few plants are the wrong colours and the wrong sizes. Things den here. They come out changed, and hungry, and toward you.
name: Vex Hollow
